title: C-DFF: Concept-Level Diagnostics for Mechanism Parity in Simulation-Based Validation of Autonomous Driving Perception
abstract: arXiv:2610.33760v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Simulation is widely used in autonomous-driving validation, but matching task outputs between real and synthetic images does not guarantee that a system relies on the same visual evidence. This creates a validation gap for transfer, especially in safety-critical perception functions. We present Concept-Decisive Feature Fidelity (C-DFF), a concept-level mechanism-parity diagnostic for paired real-synthetic evaluation. Starting from decisive evidence extracted from a frozen system-under-test (SUT), C-DFF projects that evidence into a shared semantic concept space using off-the-shelf segmentation and compares real and synthetic concept-importance vectors. The result is not only a scalar mechanism-parity score, but also a concept-shift diagnostic that identifies which scene concepts become more or less decisive in simulation. translated_title: C-DFF：面向自动驾驶感知仿真验证中机制一致性的概念级诊断方法
translated_abstract: 仿真被广泛应用于自动驾驶的验证中，但真实图像与合成图像之间任务输出的匹配并不能保证系统依赖于相同的视觉证据，这为迁移验证（尤其是安全关键的感知功能）造成了验证鸿沟。我们提出了概念决定性特征保真度（C-DFF），一种用于成对真实-合成评估的概念级机制一致性诊断方法。C-DFF从冻结的被测系统（SUT）中提取决定性证据，利用现成的分割模型将该证据投影到共享的语义概念空间中，并比较真实与合成图像的概念重要性向量。其结果不仅是标量的机制一致性评分，还包括一种概念偏移诊断，能够识别哪些场景概念在仿真中变得更或更不具决定性。我们在KITTI ↔ Virtual KITTI 2数据集上，使用2126对匹配样本，针对三个冻结的被测系统对C-DFF进行了评估。
tldr: C-DFF提出了一种概念级诊断方法，通过将被测自动驾驶感知系统的决定性证据映射到共享语义概念空间，并比较真实与合成图像的概念重要性向量，从而量化仿真验证中的机制一致性并定位概念偏移。
en_tdlr: C-DFF is a concept-level mechanism-parity diagnostic that projects decisive evidence from a frozen perception system into a shared semantic concept space and compares real-synthetic concept-importance vectors, enabling quantification of mechanism parity and localization of concept shifts in simulation-based validation of autonomous driving perception.
